visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and messy hair, wearing a blue and grey plaid shirt over a white t-shirt, sits at a wooden table against a plain white wall. He holds a smartphone and looks distressed, scratching his head while staring at the screen. (2) Close-up shot of the smartphone screen displaying an online shopping interface for a collectible item with various details and a red 'add to cart' button visible. (3) The man continues scratching his head, looking frustrated as he talks to the camera in a medium shot. (4) Another close-up of the phone screen showing the cart adding process. (5) The man's face is shown in a tight close-up, eyes wide with shock and mouth agape, with large black text on a white background overlaying the frame. (6) He is seen walking briskly through a modern office cafeteria with white tables and red chairs, holding his phone out. (7) He approaches a woman with long black hair sitting at a table; she looks indifferent while he gestures wildly with his phone. (8) Transition to a shot of him holding a lollipop, looking contemplative before returning to the cafeteria scene. (9) A new duo—a man in a white tee and a woman in denim—appear, posing dramatically at a round table with a city view behind them. (10) The duo whispers into the man's ears from both sides in a stylized shot with a warm wood background. (11) The man looks out a large window seeing a plane fly by. (12) He enters a separate office room where a different man in a white t-shirt sits in an ergonomic chair. (13) The seated man laughs hysterically, leaning back in his chair while pointing at the main character. (14) The seated man holds up a black credit card with a mascot on it. (15) Close-up of the credit card followed by the main character's ecstatic reaction holding a similar orange card. (16) The man waves goodbye and exits the room, but quickly returns looking distressed again with his phone.

(5) Fast-paced BGM continues while male and female voices list airline names rapidly, creating a sense of urgency. (6) Sudden burst of hysterical, loud male laughter with high spectral brightness and wide dynamic range. (7) Transition to a professional, high-energy promotional vocal style explaining the credit card benefits; BGM swells with a clear, rhythmic pop beat. (8) Final segment features a return to the initial frantic vocal style, punctuated by a metallic door closing sound and a final humorous vocal stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Failed Attempt -> Distraction -> Final Solution (Product) -> Recurring Humor Hook
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a comedic advertisement for the Cathay United Bank Shopee Co-branded Credit Card. The video uses a recurring scenario of a 'difficult customer' (main character) missing out on items because he waits for paydays. Through various comical encounters with office 'editors,' it introduces the credit card as the ultimate solution to earn Shopee Coins through food delivery and travel purchases, ensuring the user always has enough currency to buy items immediately.
